text:
marco-partners: Heads-up from a few marketplace vendors: they want a clear partner-level compatibility matrix and firm migration dates for the auth handshake change (tokens -> signed headers). Can we sketch a partner-first plan?

anya-sdks: Proposal: dual-mode for two full releases where SDKs accept old token header and new signed headers. Offer partner opt-in via portal to flip to strict mode early.

den-eng: Dual-mode is doable. We'll add `X-Rw-Mode: legacy|signed` request hint and emit `X-Rw-Status: legacy-accepted|signed-only` on responses. Need to gate by partner ID for progressive rollout.

li-hw: Hardware partners need longer QA. Recommend 150d public runway, opt-in canary at 60d, then 90d enforcement window. Also require a signed compatibility certificate after passing tests.

sophie-ops: Ops: we'll add partner-scoped flags `partners/handshake_v1_to_v2/<partner_id>` and autopilot rules for rollback on >1.5% error spike. Can we rely on `X-Rw-Mode` override?

anya-sdks: Yes. Docs sample for partners to toggle locally:

```
# force signed handshake for tests
curl -H "X-Rw-Mode: signed" -H "X-Rw-Client: my-app" ...
```

paul-gm: For marketplace UX: add `compatibility` badge on listings: `signed-handshake: ready|in-progress|needs-cert`. We'll also publish an ICS with certification slots.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Drafted telemetry/handshake addendum. Partners must opt into strict mode and check a portal consent box; retention language added. Review ETA 5 business days.

marco-partners: Action items: Anya -> publish SDKs dual-mode + migration snippet; Den -> PR for header/emission + flag lookup; Li -> confirm cert checklist and preferred QA dates; Sophie -> add flag automation and rollback rules; Paul -> marketplace badge + calendar. I'll compile partner-facing timeline after legal ok.

anya-sdks: I'll also add a small helper `rw.auth.wrap_for_partner(partner_id)` so partners can stage without heavy code changes.

den-eng: I'll open a prototype PR by Thursday and include tests for header precedence and partner-flag lookup.

marco-partners: Thanks all. If anyone needs to deviate from the default windows, post here so I can keep the partner-facing timeline accurate. :calendar:
